resources.string: Scan only your own networks or networks you are authorized to manage.

Ping, traceroute and port checks to a public target use the active connection (Wi-Fi, mobile data, VPN). A local address (private, CGNAT, link-local) uses Wi-Fi; without Wi-Fi only a VPN, otherwise the tool refuses it. The network scan and mDNS run on Wi-Fi outside VPN only; DNS uses the Wi-Fi resolver, without Wi-Fi the active network. Traceroute uses a system ping process without Network binding; when the default network is not the measured one it requires confirmation. On mobile data many hops do not reply, which is normal. Missing ICMP replies do not mean a host is offline. Android usually cannot provide other hosts’ MAC addresses. Ranges are limited to 4096 hosts or ports. DNS lists A/AAAA; PTR is queried for IPv4.
The selected IPv4 Wi-Fi is unavailable or changed. Refresh the network. Cellular data will not be used.
Timeout must be between 100 and 5000 ms.
Enter a valid IPv4 range with prefix 0–32.
The range exceeds 4096 hosts. Use a smaller range.
Enter ports 1–65535 as a list or ascending ranges. Maximum 4096 ports.
Enter a valid hostname or IPv4 without spaces.
Use a service type such as _http._tcp. or _ssh._tcp.
Operation failed. Check the connection, DNS, target and system restrictions. Probes support IPv4 only; DNS also lists AAAA.
This implementation requires Android 14+ for mDNS: older APIs cannot guarantee both selected Wi-Fi and cancellation of service resolution.
mDNS discovery finished after 12 seconds. Results depend on the selected service type and LAN multicast.

System ping did not provide every hop address or the target is not responding. The route is incomplete; missing hops cannot reliably be filled without raw ICMP. The test stops after five initially unknown hops.

Ping: statistics and export use the last 600 samples, the graph and list the last 120 (newest first). Loss covers the whole session. Jitter = average absolute difference between adjacent successful replies.
Round-trip time in ms · red dashed line = timeout
No results yet. Nonresponding hosts and ports without a connection are omitted.
Could not save the export. Select a file again; a full export may be at most 8 MiB.
Copying or sharing failed. Save the full export to a file.
The result exceeds the safe copy/share size (64 Ki UTF-16 characters). Save the full export to a file.
The operation timed out. Check Wi-Fi, DNS and the target, then try again.

Discover devices in %1$s automatically? When you open this screen (at most once every 5 minutes) the app sends ICMP ping, TCP probes to ports 80, 443, 22 and 445, reverse DNS and NetBIOS queries to addresses in this subnet. Allow it only on your own network or one you are permitted to manage.
The network name (SSID) is not available without the location permission, so your consent lasts only until the app is closed. Gateway and subnet alone do not identify a network.
No devices yet. Devices that answer neither ICMP nor TCP probes are not shown.
ICMP is not available on this system or VPN; discovery uses TCP probes only.
None of the common ports accepted a connection. A timeout does not mean the port is closed.
Wi-Fi with IPv4 is not available. Devices are discovered only on the current Wi-Fi; mobile data is never used.
Wi-Fi changed or disconnected during the operation. Please run it again.
This network cannot be discovered automatically (address outside private ranges). Use the Hosts tool with explicit confirmation.
The device is no longer in the list for the current network. Please discover devices again.
The system or VPN refused the ICMP socket; ping cannot be measured. The device may still be reachable over TCP.
Consent could not be saved; it applies only to the current connection to this Wi-Fi.
The operation failed. Check Wi-Fi and try again.
